BOOT.strategy: detour the call; run BOOT handlers after setup() returns, once
BOOT.note: fires a single time, right before the main loop begins

TICK.strategy: detour the call; run TICK handlers each frame, then call loop()
TICK.note: entire M8 application frame; descend into loop() for RENDER/INPUT

notes: yield (0x600B4DC0) is a long-branch veneer to the real yield().
UI strings are accessed by computed index with no static xref; RENDER/AUDIO
hooks require descending into loop()'s subsystems in Ghidra, not string xrefs.

settings_row.note: Model:02's SYSTEM SETTINGS has two more rows than headless (BATT.CHARGING row 20, FIRMWARE UPDATE row 21): the MODS row goes in row 22, field 14

loader.note: core 0.5 for Model:02, from the headless core's sites found again in 6.6.2A (code matched by instruction runs, data through the literals the matched code loads; the map with its evidence: docs/MODEL02-PORT.md). Free flash past the image (ends 0x601EB000) up to the EEPROM emulation at 0x60FC0000; the ITCM tail after the firmware's ITCM code (0x2B8D0). Built, not run on a Model:02 unit.
